messages.content: I’ll submit the first day’s DA energy and reserve plan, then adjust the battery schedule at each watch as prices and weather forecasts change. I’ll track reserve backing, cycling limits, and the required final charge.

All three DA gates are complete. Realized prices have exceeded the desk guide at several hours. The battery is now full, with nearly 100 MWh scheduled for the final evening discharge and 100 MWh retained to back the remaining reserves and meet the end-charge requirement. There have been no charged reserve failures so far.
